valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2024, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pegFormula: P/E divided by the growth rate of earnings, the growth rate expressed in percent
valuation.pegGrowthBasis: net profit compound annual growth of 2.19 percent a year from FY2023 (6.31e+08) to FY2025 (6.59e+08), over 2 years
valuation.pbFormula: price / (equity per share), equity on FY2025
valuation.pbEquityRow: total_equity on the balance sheet for FY2025
valuation.pbSharesSource: the same 5.35707e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NSE.json)
valuation.psFormula: price / (revenue per share), revenue on FY2025
valuation.psRevenueRow: the income statement's revenue line for FY2025, read from the row labelled 'Revenue'
valuation.psSharesSource: the same 5.35707e+08 shares behind the market capitalisation (static_data\market_NSE.json)
valuation.earnings_yield_withheld_reason: Withheld: the earnings behind the earnings yield are not verified: the FY2025 net profit on file, 659,000,000, is 44.5 percent above the period-matched source figure of 456,000,000, and the source's own FY2025 total equity (10,080,000,000) sits between the equity on file for FY2024 (10,645,000,000) and FY2025, so the two sides differ in the non-controlling interests' share of profit and nothing on file settles which basis this P/E should stand on. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
